gates.title: Finalized state integrity and merge accounting
gates.pass_condition: Recompute the #420 four-parent 840->841 merge from source-pinned event logs; record final_scope_rejected_chains, rejections_without_a_conflict, unapplied_kept_writes, and each accepted/rejected deploy effect. Add isolated sequential and parallel hot-cell regression.
gates.fail_condition: A finalized accepted effect disappears without a legitimate transition, or merge accounting cannot explain the witness.
gates.observable: MergeReport accounting fields; per-chain effect verdict; accepted/rejected deploy effects; sequential and parallel hot-cell regressions.
gates.negative_control: A fabricated missing effect must be rejected; a block with rejectedDeploys: [] does not establish an empty final-scope rejected-chain set; every kept datum/kont/native effect must be read back from the produced state.
gates.status_reason: The authenticated historical 840->841 bundle is UNAVAILABLE (owner decision 2026-11-15, comment 6892934659). M5-04/M5-06 component accounting is verified; it is not the historical M5 gate. Unavailability is a continuing blocker, not a waiver.

related.criterion: A:block-merge is an open semantic decision, not an M5 witness
sidecar-merge is cost composition, not per-chain accounting
the merge-diff row is one merge-accounting component

gates.does_not_claim: Component/hot-cell accounting is not the historical 840->841 replay; the unavailable bundle is not a pass.

gates.title: Reproducibility and independent sign-off
gates.pass_condition: Preserve binary/source SHA, host/config/stake/clock boundaries, hashes of protected log snapshots, deploy IDs, included/finalized block hashes, test commands, CI runs, raw outcomes, reviewer conclusions and explicit non-claims.
gates.fail_condition: Undocumented configuration, unsupported hardware inference, private-only unverifiable pass assertions, or missing provenance.
gates.observable: A reproducibility record with every pin, boundary, hash, command, raw outcome, reviewer conclusion and non-claim; the reviewer is independent and the record is digest-pinned.
gates.negative_control: A record missing a pin or a non-claim must fail; a pin that is not 40/64-hex must fail; a self-authored review must fail the independence rule.
gates.status_reason: No selected candidate reproducibility record or independent reviewer conclusion exists.

related.criterion: the #584 verdict is a live-run sign-off, not the full M6 reproducibility review
the section-6 category-A disposition is a separate audit sign-off
C357 acceptance is a narrow hardfork boundary, not M6

gates.does_not_claim: One sign-off does not discharge M6, G6, the section-6 audit and C357 together.

gates.title: Independent verdict
gates.pass_condition: PASS / FAIL / INCONCLUSIVE recorded by the named independent reviewer against G1-G5, with the evidence record cited.
gates.fail_condition: No verdict, a verdict by a non-independent reviewer, or a verdict that does not cite the evidence.
gates.observable: The named reviewer's verdict, independence attestation, and the cited evidence record.
gates.negative_control: A self-authored verdict must fail; a free-text README with no typed reviewer record must fail; a FAIL or INCONCLUSIVE does not close the gate.
gates.status_reason: No verdict exists; the live run has not executed.

related.criterion: G6 is a subset of the M6 reproducibility and sign-off gate

gates.does_not_claim: G6 does not discharge M6 or the #51 audit sign-off.

gates.title: Every attack vector is handled
gates.pass_condition: Not a pass/fail item: a rate and class census against the bounded-adversary statement in docs/src/spec/adversary.md.
gates.fail_condition: Not applicable: a census must not be reported as PASS or FAIL.
gates.observable: The rate/class census and the bounded-adversary statement.
gates.negative_control: Do not report a census as PASS.
gates.status_reason: Census only; the bounded-adversary statement exists at docs/src/spec/adversary.md, and the census is not a pass/fail verdict.
gates.does_not_claim: This criterion cannot go green by construction.

gates.title: Self-replay recovery and section-6 lockstep acceptance
gates.pass_condition: The selected release, every validator in lockstep (or a coordinated new genesis), an independent category-A verdict, and the owner-approved reconstructed trace with the reviewer's explicit acceptance.
gates.fail_condition: A mixed-version rollout, a self-authored or unpinned verdict, or a reconstructed trace without both acceptances.
gates.observable: The acceptance record's shape, derived lockstep/mixed-version, the selected pins, the independence attestation, the verdict URL and digest, and the reconstructed-trace decision.
gates.negative_control: A mixed-version activation span must fail; a self-authored review must fail; a reconstructed trace without the owner's decision URL or the reviewer's acceptance must FAIL (with --require-original-trace it is PRECONDITION); a record with no declared lockstep window is PRECONDITION.
gates.status_reason: No selected release lockstep campaign, independent category-A verdict, or reconstructed-trace acceptance exists. The #584 candidate/GO is a related live arm, not C357 closure.

related.criterion: C357 acceptance is a narrow hardfork boundary, not the M6 reproducibility review
the #584 verdict is a live-run sign-off, not the C357 lockstep acceptance

gates.does_not_claim: The acceptance checker validates a record; it does not prove a campaign ran.

gates.title: Populated-store migration and replay qualification
gates.pass_condition: An exact-format populated-store copy/rollback/restart acceptance, including replay qualification, before a store swap.
gates.fail_condition: A populated store is swapped without an exact-format copy/rollback/restart acceptance or a replay qualification.
gates.observable: The copy/rollback/restart result and the replay verdict on the populated store.
gates.negative_control: A fresh-genesis run must not substitute for the populated-store arm.
gates.status_reason: No in-tree gate row or witness; the dependency is recorded but unqualified.

related.criterion: the populated-store migration is an M4 prerequisite

gates.does_not_claim: A fresh-genesis or debug-build run is not a populated-store migration.

gates.title: Checkpoint v3 (Law 117): fringeHeadersRoot sync-protocol rule
gates.pass_condition: A source-pinned replay/compatibility acceptance for checkpoint v3: a v2 and v3 node are not mixed across a cold join; the join input set is the v3 set; an absent root is the legitimate v2 statement.
gates.fail_condition: The rule remains prose-only with no row digest, per-candidate disposition or compatibility decision, or a v2/v3 cold join is mixed.
gates.observable: The checkpoint statement's fringeHeadersRoot, the joiner's verification, and the cold-join input set.
gates.negative_control: A v2/v3 cold-join mix must fail; a prose-only correction must not pass.
gates.status_reason: Prose-only correction; not in the 94-row inventory or a per-candidate disposition.

related.criterion: the v3 statement is a selected-candidate prerequisite

gates.does_not_claim: The prose correction is not an independent safety attestation.

gates.title: Merge fork rule (Law 115): trimmed conflict scope
gates.pass_condition: A source-pinned replay/compatibility acceptance for the trimmed conflict-scope rule; all validators upgrade in lockstep, or the owner records an accepted-history compatibility decision or coordinated new genesis.
gates.fail_condition: The widened-scope block is accepted by the trimmed rule without a compatibility decision, or the rule remains prose-only.
gates.observable: Block acceptance under the trimmed scope, the dependency closure, and the lockstep/continuation decision.
gates.negative_control: A widened-scope block must be rejected by the trimmed rule; a mixed-version node set must fail.
gates.status_reason: Prose-only correction; not in the 94-row inventory or a per-candidate disposition.

related.criterion: the trimmed rule is a selected-candidate prerequisite

gates.does_not_claim: The prose correction is not an independent safety attestation.
